item.title: Giving Thanks for a Left Coast Surfing Life
item.description: The author came to his West Coast surf town by chance. But found himself part of the local community, with a love for the place he didn't know was possible.

item.title: Skiers and Snowboarders in Italy Are Now Required By Law to Wear Helmets
item.description: It'd be tough to find a ski resort on the planet where people without helmets outnumber the people wearing them. Now it's a requirement for everybody in Italy.

item.title: People May Be Warming Up to Sharks, Study Says
item.description: According to a new study that analyzed words people associated with sharks, humans' perceptions of the ocean predators may be softening a little.

item.title: Watch Snowboarder Sebastien Toutant Complete 22-Obstacle, 10-Sport Run in One Take
item.description: Snowboarder Sebastien Toutant is the king of the obstacle course. Here, he goes deep with a 22-obstacle course that included 10 different sports.

item.title: 500 Endangered Caspian Seals Washed Up Dead In Russia
item.description: Caspian seals are in a bad way. They are classified as endangered, and their dwindling numbers were dealt a severe blow when almost 500 of them washed up dead.

item.title: The United States of America Versus Sam George
item.description: The Inertia's Sam George writes about the time the Internal Revenue Service came looking for him regarding undocumented expenses pertaining to surfing.

item.title: John John Florence Is Registered to Compete in the Pipe Pro
item.description: John John Florence may come back to competition even sooner than we expected. It appears he’ll enter the Pipe Pro, running December 10 - 20.

item.title: Howling Offshores Create Insanely Long Barrels in Cape Town, South Africa
item.description: Howling offshores are nice, aren't they? If you're looking for long tubes, the tip of South Africa when all the stars align is a good place to start.

item.title: Surfer Still Hasn’t Gotten Refund After Airline Ran Over His Boards With a Stair Car
item.description: Welsh surfer William Beck had his board bag absolutely annihilated by an airline a few months ago and still has yet to see a dime for the destroyed equipment.

item.title: Jaws Lights Up as Season’s First XL West Swell Hits Maui
item.description: Well, it's that time of year again. It's the time that Jaws surfers live for: Peahi's opening day. A massive XL swell marched in from the west and Jaws lit up.
